b: Tomorrow is an important meeting of the Coalition of the Willing. We are doing everything together with our partners to make our Coalition effective. We are preparing new support packages for Ukraine – primarily for our defense and our energy sector. There will also be bilateral meetings that should deliver more for Ukraine and our diplomacy.

We are counting on a meeting with envoys of the U.S. President, and we will speak with European leaders about our next steps in the negotiations with Russians. Ukraine is clearly asserting its commitment to peace, and we always work constructively. The American envoys said that in Berlin, during our meetings, they would give us a debrief on the talks the American President is currently holding, including in China. We will also be hearing from other countries and other leaders – our partners currently in China.

We and the Europeans have a clear, shared position: issues concerning Ukraine must be decided with Ukraine’s participation, and issues concerning Europe must be decided with Europe’s participation. This is the only approach there can ever be. Thank you to everyone who is helping and who is pushing for a strong agenda to bring this war to an end.
